name: 22193 · Woodbridge, VA
findings: ZIP 22193 (Woodbridge) has 213 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22193 (Woodbridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 16 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
